name: Hinamizawa Kaiki Navigator Tsumikegare
original_name: 雛見沢怪奇ナビゲーター 罪穢
source:
June 1983. In the cold Hinamizawa village population protests in vain against construction of a dam. Main character arrives to the deserted village after the struggle and experiences mysterious tragedy through communication with “Oyashirosama”, a being similar to Kokukuri-san..

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1983年6月。寒冷的雏见泽村因水坝建设而举行抗议，却徒劳无功。主角在斗争结束后抵达这座荒废的村庄，并通过与类似“狐狗狸”的存在“御社神大人”交流，经历了一场神秘悲剧……

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
